lead.title: SRTD (Jülich) raises a €31.5M seed led by Mérieux Equity Partners for RNA that switches on only in diseased cells
lead.deck: Mérieux Equity Partners leads the round with the Boehringer Ingelheim Venture Fund as co-lead, alongside NRW.BANK (€7M), Lilly Ventures, High-Tech Gründerfonds and the Anobis family office. Built on research from Forschungszentrum Jülich, the company pairs a "selectively expressed" RNA (seRNA), which stays inactive until it meets a disease-specific RNA marker, with in-house fusogenic lipid nanoparticles, and will use the money to ready its cancer, autoimmune and fibrosis programs for the clinic.

milestone.title: European Commission clears Pepaxti (melflufen) from third line in multiple myeloma
milestone.summary: Under the November 9 decision, Pepaxti is now indicated in adults after at least two prior lines whose disease is refractory to lenalidomide and to the last line, with no triple-class-refractory requirement. The decision confirms September's positive CHMP opinion, based on the Phase 3 OCEAN trial.
milestone.why: Oncopeptides estimates the eligible patient pool in Europe roughly doubles; a German access dossier follows within about a month and the company targets positive cash flow in 2027 — a textbook case of a small biotech widening its label to reach profitability.

deal.thesis: London's former Kesmalea rebrands and raises $60M led by 4BIO Capital, with Eli Lilly, CE Ventures, Actium Group and TOHO Ventures joining Syncona and Oxford Science Enterprises. The thesis: its SELFTAC platform gets two small halves into the cell that reassemble into a bifunctional degrader, aiming at an oral, brain-penetrant tau degrader for Alzheimer's — targeted protein degradation applied to the CNS, where the size of classic PROTACs is a roadblock.

brefsEurope.title: Neobe raises a $6.8M seed led by ARC Ventures for bacteria that open up the matrix of solid tumors
brefsEurope.summary: Faber, Macmillan Ventures, Proven Connect and Empirical Ventures join; the NEO22 program (hyaluronidase-producing bacteria) is set to reach an IND filing in 2028.

brefsEurope.title: argenx buys its macrocyclic-peptide partner Unnatural Products for up to $1.15B
brefsEurope.summary: $550M in cash upfront and up to $595M in milestones; the target already works with argenx on an oral FcRn inhibitor, a possible alternative to injectable Vyvgart. Comparable: the premium paid for an oral modality in autoimmunity.

brefsEurope.title: Valneva: two positive Phase 2 trials for S4V2, a tetravalent bioconjugate Shigella vaccine
brefsEurope.summary: Antibody responses against all four serotypes in 110 Kenyan infants; the adult controlled human infection trial met its primary endpoint against S. sonnei. No Shigella vaccine is licensed.

brefsEurope.title: Immunocore: 70% estimated two-year survival pairing brenetafusp with Kimmtrak in metastatic uveal melanoma
brefsEurope.summary: Phase 1/2 cohort (17 evaluable first-line patients, versus 45% for Kimmtrak alone in Phase 3, a non-randomized comparison); a randomized Phase 2/3 trial, DUET-UVEAL, is planned.

brefsEurope.title: Mendus and NorthX Biologics to manufacture donor-derived "memory" NK cells, with Vinnova backing
brefsEurope.summary: A SEK 977,300 grant to set up manufacturing of these cells, being evaluated in AML patients after stem cell transplantation; a project separate from lead candidate vididencel.

brefsEurope.title: Institut Pasteur spin-off Oncovita wins EU orphan designation for MVdeltaC in mesothelioma
brefsEurope.summary: An oncolytic virus derived from the Schwarz measles vaccine strain (Measovir platform); already an orphan drug in the US, it is preclinical, with a first trial targeted for late 2027.

brefsEurope.title: TECregen names Elisabeth Svanberg CMO and adds Thomas Hanke (CARMA FUND) to its board
brefsEurope.summary: The thymus-regeneration company is advancing TEC001, an engineered KGF for uremia-associated immunodeficiency; Svanberg was Chief Development Officer at Ixaltis and sits on the boards of Galapagos and LEO Pharma.

brefsEurope.title: Vale Biolabs wins CHF 150,000 from Venture Kick to predict brain-drug failures on organoids
brefsEurope.summary: The Zurich-area startup measures how standardized human brain organoids respond to drugs and turns the data into predictive AI models (neurodegeneration, brain aging).

brefsIntl.title: Beam hits the primary endpoint of pivotal BEACON and readies the first BLA for a base-editing therapy
brefsIntl.summary: risto-cel (formerly BEAM-101) eliminated severe vaso-occlusive crises for at least 12 months in sickle cell disease; filing targeted as early as year-end 2026, a regulatory precedent for all of European gene editing.

word.definition: A tiny bubble of fats that wraps a fragile RNA, protects it in the bloodstream and carries it into cells, as in the Covid mRNA vaccines.

parts.label: Ionizable lipid
parts.role: the engine: it binds the RNA during manufacturing and turns positive in the acidic endosome, releasing the cargo

parts.label: Helper lipids (DSPC, cholesterol)
parts.role: the frame: shape, stability and membrane fusion

parts.label: PEG-lipid
parts.role: the coat: prevents aggregation, but slows cell entry if there is too much

how.t: The RNA and the four lipids are mixed at acidic pH: the positively charged ionizable lipid captures the negatively charged RNA and the particle closes up.

Injected into the blood, the particle picks up apolipoprotein E and is taken up mainly by the liver via the LDL receptor; reaching another organ requires changing the formulation or the route (nasal, inhaled).

In the acidifying endosome, the ionizable lipid becomes protonated and destabilizes the membrane; only a small fraction of the RNA, often cited as under 5%, escapes into the cytoplasm, where it is translated.

word.why: LNPs are clinically validated (Onpattro, Comirnaty, Spikevax) but end up in the liver by default: value is shifting to formulations that target other tissues (lung, tumor, immune system). For a VC, a proprietary delivery platform is often an RNA biotech's most defensible asset — SRTD's €31.5M raise, built on in-house fusogenic LNPs, makes the point. Due-diligence watch item: intellectual property on the ionizable lipid.

startups.name: SRTD Biotech
startups.use: Pairs its selectively expressed RNAs (seRNA) with proprietary fusogenic LNPs for organ-specific distribution; €31.5M seed led by Mérieux Equity Partners in November 2026.

startups.name: Ethris
startups.use: Lipidoid-based SNaP LNP platform for local airway delivery; its nasal mRNA ETH47 (interferon lambda) has completed a Phase 2a rhinovirus challenge study.

startups.name: NanoZymeX
startups.use: University of Basel spin-off encapsulating enzymes in LNPs for enzyme replacement therapy (Pompe); CHF 150,000 from Venture Kick in March 2026.

startups.name: ReCode Therapeutics
startups.use: SORT (Selective Organ Targeting) platform for inhaled mRNAs; first proof of activity in a Phase 1b trial in primary ciliary dyskinesia (May 2026).
